overview_description.description: clicOH is the leading vertical AI-powered last-mile logistics company in Latin America. It enables top enterprises in banking, retail, telecoms, and e-commerce to ship faster, more reliably, and at lower cost. The company combines real-time routing, a flexible driver network, and end-to-end visibility to handle millions of shipments across Argentina, Mexico and Colombia. From credit cards to consumer goods, clicOH powers the logistics backbone for companies that need speed and trust at scale.
